acne.name: Acne & Breakout Prone
acne.tagline: Regulate sebum production, balance insulin spikes, and pacify systemic inflammation.

keyNutrients.name: Zinc (Chelated / Bioavailable)
keyNutrients.benefit: Helps downregulate sebum excretion, mitigates Cutibacterium acnes colonization, and accelerates dermal wound healing.
keyNutrients.sources: Pumpkin seeds, soaked chickpeas, lentils, oysters, hemp seeds

keyNutrients.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (EPA/DHA)
keyNutrients.benefit: Inhibits leukotriene B4 and inflammatory cytokines, reducing redness and cystic swelling.
keyNutrients.sources: Flaxseeds, chia seeds, walnuts, wild salmon, sardines

keyNutrients.name: Vitamin A & Carotenoids
keyNutrients.benefit: Supports normal follicular keratinization, preventing dead cell cohesion and micro-comedone formation.
keyNutrients.sources: Sweet potatoes, carrots, spinach, methi (fenugreek) leaves

keyNutrients.name: Probiotics & Prebiotics
keyNutrients.benefit: Modulates the gut-skin axis, reducing circulating endotoxins and systemic acne flare-ups.
keyNutrients.sources: Probiotic curd (dahi), kefir, lacto-fermented pickles, garlic, leeks

foodsToEat.reason: Rich in enzymatic zinc, antioxidants, and low-glycemic plant protein that stabilizes postprandial insulin.
Provides beneficial Lactobacillus strains that calm the gut-skin axis; buttermilk is naturally cooling and light.
High in alpha-linolenic acid (ALA) omega-3s which thin thick follicular sebum and combat inflammation.
Curcumin delivers potent lipoxygenase and COX-2 suppression to reduce active inflammatory pustules.
Mega-doses of natural polyphenols and vitamin C that protect sebum from lipid peroxidation.
Supplies chlorophyll, folate, and magnesium to facilitate hepatic clearing of circulating metabolic byproducts.

foodsToLimit.reason: Triggers rapid insulin surges, elevating IGF-1 which stimulates sebaceous gland androgen receptors and pore blockage.
Creates advanced glycation end-products (AGEs) and triggers systemic inflammatory cascades.

foodsToLimit.item: Commercial Skim Milk & Whey Protein Powders
foodsToLimit.reason: Contains concentrated bovine hormones and IGF-1 precursors shown to exacerbate comedonal acne.
High omega-6 to omega-3 ratio alters sebum fatty acid composition, rendering it more comedogenic.

acne.hydrationTip: Drink 2.5–3 liters of water daily. Enhance with fresh mint, cucumber slices, or a squeeze of amla for antioxidant cellular hydration.

breakfast.veg: Steel-cut oatmeal prepared with almond milk, topped with 1 tbsp ground flaxseeds, chia seeds, and 1/2 cup fresh berries or stewed apple.
breakfast.nonVeg: Poached eggs (2) on sprouted grain sourdough with sliced avocado and grilled tomatoes, served with green tea.

lunch.veg: Warm yellow moong dal, 1 bowl of lightly steamed palak (spinach) sabzi, a small portion of brown basmati rice or millet roti, and a bowl of fresh unsweetened curd.
lunch.nonVeg: Grilled wild salmon or mackerel filet seasoned with turmeric and cumin, served with sautéed greens and warm quinoa.

snack.veg: Sprouted moong chaat with diced cucumber, tomatoes, lemon juice, and a pinch of black salt + a tall glass of light mint buttermilk (chaas).
snack.nonVeg: Boiled egg whites (2) dusted with chaat masala and a handful of raw soaked walnuts + unsweetened green tea.

dinner.veg: Tofu and vegetable stir-fry with broccoli, bell peppers, zucchini, and sesame seeds in a light ginger-garlic tamari broth.
dinner.nonVeg: Herbed chicken breast cooked in olive oil with steamed asparagus, roast sweet potato cubes, and fresh lemon-herb dressing.

eczema.name: Eczema & Atopic Dermatitis
eczema.tagline: Strengthen the filaggrin barrier, quench mast-cell histamine reactivity, and nourish dry dermal layers.

keyNutrients.name: Quercetin (Bioflavonoid)
keyNutrients.benefit: Natural mast-cell stabilizer that dampens histamine release and reduces itch and erythema.
keyNutrients.sources: Red onions, capers, apples with peel, kale, blueberries

keyNutrients.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids & GLA
keyNutrients.benefit: Rebuilds defective intercellular lipid cement and reduces trans-epidermal water loss (TEWL).
keyNutrients.sources: Hemp seed oil, evening primrose oil, flaxseeds, wild fatty fish

keyNutrients.name: Vitamin D3
keyNutrients.benefit: Enhances cathelicidin antimicrobial peptide expression, protecting fragile atopic skin from secondary infection.
keyNutrients.sources: Mushrooms exposed to UV, egg yolks, fortified oat milk, fatty fish

keyNutrients.name: Zinc & Silica
keyNutrients.benefit: Crucial cofactors for collagen synthesis and rapid re-epithelialization of cracked barriers.
keyNutrients.sources: Pumpkin seeds, cucumbers with skin, bamboo shoots, lentils

foodsToEat.reason: Potent anti-inflammatory liquid base that calms the intestinal lining and systemic mast cells.
Delivers gentle vitamin E and healthy lipids to reinforce intercellular skin lamellae.

foodsToEat.item: Moong Dal Khichdi with Desi Cow Ghee (Moderate)
foodsToEat.reason: Extremely gentle, hypoallergenic, and grounding; pure A2 ghee provides butyric acid for gut integrity.
Provides flavonoid protection that naturally downregulates systemic itch sensations.
Ultra-gentle alkaline vegetables with high water content and zero histamine burden.

foodsToLimit.reason: Aged cheeses, cured meats, wine, and vinegars can directly provoke intense pruritus and skin itching.
Known triggers for atopic flare-ups and mucosal irritation.
May heighten inflammatory alkaloid sensitivity in flare-prone individuals.
Emulsifiers disrupt the intestinal mucosal lining, allowing antigens into systemic circulation.

eczema.hydrationTip: Prioritize room-temperature water and soothing infusions like chamomile or fennel seed tea. Avoid piping hot liquids that dilate skin capillaries.

breakfast.veg: Warm rolled oats cooked with water or almond milk, topped with stewed sweet apple slices, cinnamon, and 1 tbsp hemp hearts.
breakfast.nonVeg: Scrambled eggs with fresh baby spinach cooked in a dash of cold-pressed coconut oil, served with sliced ripe avocado.

lunch.veg: Nourishing moong dal khichdi prepared with carrots and bottle gourd, finished with 1/2 tsp pure A2 cow ghee and a side of fresh grated cucumber.
lunch.nonVeg: Poached white fish or chicken breast with steamed sweet potatoes and roasted zucchini in an herb-infused bone broth.

snack.veg: A cup of warm chamomile tea paired with a small handful of soaked, peeled almonds and pumpkin seeds.
snack.nonVeg: Warm clear bone broth or vegetable broth seasoned with grated ginger, turmeric, and sea salt.

dinner.veg: Soft paneer or organic tofu sautéed with blanched green beans, carrots, and sweet potato mash.
dinner.nonVeg: Oven-baked cod or salmon filet served with steamed broccoli florets and butternut squash puree.

fungal_infection.name: Fungal Infection & Malassezia / Tinea
fungal_infection.tagline: Starve yeast overgrowth by eliminating simple sugars while infusing natural antifungal botanicals.

keyNutrients.name: Caprylic & Lauric Acids
keyNutrients.benefit: Breaks through fungal biofilm and disrupts cell membranes of Malassezia and Candida yeasts.
keyNutrients.sources: Virgin unrefined coconut oil, palm kernel oil

keyNutrients.name: Allicin
keyNutrients.benefit: Potent broad-spectrum antifungal botanical compound activated upon crushing fresh raw garlic.
keyNutrients.sources: Freshly crushed garlic, chives, shallots

keyNutrients.name: L-Glutamine
keyNutrients.benefit: Fuel for enterocytes that seals intestinal tight junctions to block fungal translocation.
keyNutrients.sources: Cabbage juice, bone broth, spinach, beans

keyNutrients.name: Antioxidant Polyphenols
keyNutrients.benefit: Supports immune defense against dermatophytes and enhances skin cell turnover.
keyNutrients.sources: Green tea (EGCG), oregano, thyme, cloves

foodsToEat.item: Crushed Fresh Garlic in Warm Meals
foodsToEat.reason: Allicin possesses clinically verified fungistatic activity against Malassezia and Trichophyton.
Rich in caprylic and lauric acid which naturally inhibit fungal spore germination.
Crowds out pathogenic yeasts on mucosal and digestive surfaces with competitive beneficial flora.
Contains carvacrol and eugenol, both potent natural antifungal plant actives.
Supplies indole-3-carbinol and glucosinolates to bolster phase II liver clearance of fungal metabolites.

foodsToLimit.reason: Simple carbohydrates serve as the primary fuel source for rapid fungal proliferation and colonization.
Cross-reactive allergens and extraneous yeast strains that can exacerbate fungal sensitivities.
Concentrated fructose feeds intestinal and peripheral yeast populations.
Spikes blood sugar levels, increasing glucose secretion in perspiration which feeds fungal skin microflora.

fungal_infection.hydrationTip: Drink 3 liters of water. Include 1–2 cups of green tea with a slice of fresh lemon, or warm water infused with crushed cloves.

breakfast.veg: Besan (chickpea flour) cheela loaded with finely chopped onions, spinach, and ajwain, cooked in virgin coconut oil with fresh mint-coriander chutney.
breakfast.nonVeg: Omelette made with 2 eggs, fresh chopped garlic, tomatoes, and parsley in coconut oil, served with green tea.

lunch.veg: Sprouted chana and masoor dal cooked with crushed garlic and jeera, paired with steamed cauliflower and cabbage sabzi.
lunch.nonVeg: Grilled oregano chicken breast served alongside steamed broccoli, sauteed green beans, and cauliflower rice.

snack.veg: A bowl of plain unsweetened dahi with roasted cumin and crushed flaxseed + a cup of hot thyme-oregano tea.
snack.nonVeg: Roasted pumpkin seeds and walnut halves with unsweetened spiced ginger green tea.

dinner.veg: Warm vegetable stew featuring cabbage, carrots, French beans, and tofu simmered in a coconut milk and crushed garlic broth.
dinner.nonVeg: Steamed white fish filet with garlic-lemon drizzle, asparagus spears, and a crisp cucumber salad.

pigmentation.name: Hyperpigmentation & Melasma
pigmentation.tagline: Suppress tyrosinase activity, intercept UV-induced free radicals, and promote clean cellular turnover.

keyNutrients.name: Vitamin C (L-Ascorbic Acid)
keyNutrients.benefit: Competitively inhibits copper ions at the tyrosinase active site, reducing melanin polymerization.
keyNutrients.sources: Amla (Indian gooseberry), bell peppers, citrus fruits, guava, kiwi

keyNutrients.name: Glutathione Precursors (NAC & Glycine)
keyNutrients.benefit: Converts dark eumelanin into lighter pheomelanin and neutralizes photo-oxidative stress.
keyNutrients.sources: Asparagus, avocado, walnuts, sulphur-rich onions, garlic, eggs

keyNutrients.name: Niacinamide (Vitamin B3)
keyNutrients.benefit: Inhibits melanosome transfer from melanocytes to surrounding keratinocytes by up to 68%.
keyNutrients.sources: Legumes, mushrooms, sunflower seeds, green peas, poultry

keyNutrients.name: Lycopene & Beta-Carotene
keyNutrients.benefit: Internal photoprotectant that increases dermal erythema threshold against UVA/UVB rays.
keyNutrients.sources: Cooked tomatoes, watermelon, pink grapefruit, carrots, papaya

foodsToEat.item: Fresh Indian Gooseberry (Amla) Juice or Fruit
foodsToEat.reason: Contains 20x more stable vitamin C than oranges, directly mitigating tyrosinase hyperactivity.

foodsToEat.item: Cooked Tomato Sauce / Puree with Olive Oil
foodsToEat.reason: Cooking liberates bioavailable lycopene, which embeds in cell membranes to absorb solar UV radiation.
Loaded with ascorbic acid, lutein, and zeaxanthin that defend against blue light and UV pigmentation.
Contains natural papain enzymes and carotenoids that stimulate gentle, natural epidermal cell turnover.
High in epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG) which attenuates melanogenesis triggered by inflammatory sunburn.

foodsToLimit.reason: Heterocyclic amines and advanced lipoxidation end-products induce dermal pigment darkening.
Depletes hepatic glutathione stores, leaving melanocytes vulnerable to oxidative hyper-reactivity.

foodsToLimit.item: Excessive Coffee on an Empty Stomach
foodsToLimit.reason: Elevates morning cortisol levels, which can trigger hormonal melasma flare-ups along cheekbones.
Easily peroxidized under UV sunlight, creating reactive lipid fragments that stimulate melanocytes.

pigmentation.hydrationTip: Infuse cold water with fresh citrus slices, amla extract, and mint leaves to continuously circulate bioflavonoids through peripheral capillaries.

breakfast.nonVeg: Whole grain toast with 2 poached eggs, sliced ripe tomatoes drizzled with extra virgin olive oil, and fresh kiwi.

lunch.veg: Sprouted moong dal with cooked tomato-onion gravy, sautéed bell peppers and paneer cubes, served with a small bowl of quinoa or red rice.
lunch.nonVeg: Grilled skinless chicken breast with warm spiced tomato ragout, roasted red bell peppers, and fresh mixed greens.

snack.veg: A bowl of fresh guava or orange slices dusted with roasted cumin powder + a cup of ceremonial matcha or green tea.
snack.nonVeg: A handful of raw walnuts and pumpkin seeds + cold citrus-infused green tea.

dinner.veg: Baked tofu cubes glazed in ginger-lemon tamari, served over steamed broccoli, asparagus, and carrot puree.
dinner.nonVeg: Pan-seared salmon with lemon-herb butter, roasted asparagus, and steamed sweet potato medallions.

dryness.name: Dryness & Barrier Dehydration
dryness.tagline: Rehydrate interstitial matrices, seal in lipid reserves, and end dull flaky tightness.

keyNutrients.name: Ceramides & Phospholipids
keyNutrients.benefit: Forms the essential waterproof cellular mortar that locks moisture into the stratum corneum.
keyNutrients.sources: Soy lecithin, wheat germ, egg yolk, sunflower lecithin

keyNutrients.name: Hyaluronic Acid Precursors & Glucosamine
keyNutrients.benefit: Stimulates glycosaminoglycan synthesis in dermal fibroblasts to retain 1,000x its weight in water.
keyNutrients.sources: Bone broth, cartilage extracts, root vegetables, citrus

keyNutrients.name: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol)
keyNutrients.benefit: Fat-soluble membrane antioxidant that shields intracellular lipids from desiccation.
keyNutrients.sources: Almonds, sunflower seeds, avocado, cold-pressed olive oil

keyNutrients.name: Electrolytes (Potassium & Magnesium)
keyNutrients.benefit: Regulates aquaporin water channels across epidermal keratinocyte membranes.
keyNutrients.sources: Coconut water, bananas, leafy greens, pumpkin seeds

foodsToEat.reason: Nature's optimal electrolyte balance (potassium, sodium, magnesium) that restores deep intracellular hydration.

foodsToEat.item: Ripe Hass Avocado & Cold-Pressed Olive Oil
foodsToEat.reason: Packed with monounsaturated oleic acid that restores soft, supple flexibility to rough stratum corneum.
Supplies hydrophilic soluble fiber that slowly releases hydration alongside fat-soluble vitamin E.

foodsToEat.item: Warm Dal with a Touch of Ghee
foodsToEat.reason: Ayurvedically recognized for lubricating internal tissues (Snehana) and smoothing dry rough skin.
Delivers structured gel-water bound with natural trace minerals for enhanced cellular uptake.

foodsToLimit.reason: Accelerates fluid excretion through kidneys, exacerbating trans-epidermal water deficit.
Distorts cellular osmotic pressure, pulling hydration away from outer epidermal skin layers.
Depresses antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin), inducing severe morning skin dullness and fine dehydration lines.
Starves the skin of critical linoleic acid and cholesterol necessary for lamellar lipid synthesis.

dryness.hydrationTip: Aim for 8–10 glasses of mineralized water. Sip continuously throughout the day rather than chugging large amounts at once. Start morning with warm water + pinch of pink Himalayan salt.

breakfast.nonVeg: Avocado toast on whole grain bread topped with two sunny-side eggs drizzled with cold-pressed olive oil and chia seeds.

lunch.nonVeg: Hearty chicken bone broth with tender chicken chunks, carrots, celery, sweet potato, and fresh parsley.

snack.nonVeg: A cup of warm bone broth or golden milk made with almond milk, turmeric, and 1/2 tsp ghee.

dinner.veg: Creamy coconut and butternut squash curry with paneer or tofu, served over warm brown rice or soft whole wheat phulka.
dinner.nonVeg: Baked salmon with creamy dill sauce, roasted butternut squash, and steamed baby spinach.

general_barrier.name: General Barrier Health & Radiance
general_barrier.tagline: Sustain epidermal equilibrium, boost cellular longevity, and cultivate an effortless inner luminescence.

keyNutrients.name: Antioxidant Polyphenols
keyNutrients.benefit: Neutralizes ambient particulate pollution and UV stress to maintain youthful collagen matrices.
keyNutrients.sources: Pomegranate, berries, dark chocolate (85%+), green tea, turmeric

keyNutrients.name: Complete Plant & Marine Proteins
keyNutrients.benefit: Supplies essential amino acids (proline, lysine, glycine) needed for continuous dermal protein synthesis.
keyNutrients.sources: Moong dal, eggs, fish, tofu, edamame, hemp seeds

keyNutrients.name: Carotenoids & Vitamin E
keyNutrients.benefit: Enriches the lipid mantle to preserve natural radiance and smooth skin micro-relief.
keyNutrients.sources: Carrots, sweet potatoes, almonds, spinach, sunflower seeds

keyNutrients.name: Zinc & Selenium
keyNutrients.benefit: Essential trace minerals for antioxidant enzyme systems (glutathione peroxidase, superoxide dismutase).
keyNutrients.sources: Brazil nuts (1 daily), pumpkin seeds, whole grains

foodsToEat.reason: Packed with ellagic acid and punicalagins that prevent collagen degradation and enhance micro-circulation.
A complete, easily digestible protein and fiber source that nourishes both microbiome and skin.
Cultivates diverse gut microbiotics for clear, glowing complexions and reduced inflammation.
Delivers daily essential fatty acids and vitamin E to nourish cell membranes.
Supplies a diverse spectrum of phytochemicals for multifaceted cellular antioxidant defense.

foodsToLimit.reason: Accelerates skin stiffening and collagen glycation through AGE formation.
Creates oxidative damage that dulls natural dermal translucency.
Causes fluid retention and facial puffiness while dehydrating deep skin tissues.

general_barrier.hydrationTip: Maintain 8 glasses of pure water every day. Supplement with coconut water or warm herbal tea for sustained cellular vitality.
